description: Two products of the same quantity on one time axis (e.g. IMERG and CHIRPS weekly area means). Each binding maps its own variable name to the same columns, the shared x/y/color encodings sit at the top level, and each layer only picks its data and a constant color datum, which becomes its legend entry. The y title is the default (both variables have the same long_name and units). Inputs: -i imerg=<Zarr: time, variable precipitation_surface> -i chirps=<Zarr: time, variable precip>.
